tools.description: This is a fine-tuned version of the multi-modal LayoutLM model for the task of question answering on invoices and other documents. It has been fine-tuned on a proprietary dataset of invoices as well as both SQuAD2.0 and DocVQA for general comprehension. Unlike other QA models, which can only extract consecutive tokens (because they predict the start and end of a sequence), this model can predict longer-range, non-consecutive sequences with an additional classifier head.
